title: Hot Take: Inside LeBron's first game in Philly -- more than two decades ago
author: Rico
summary: ESPN's "Inside LeBron's first game in Philly -- more than two decades ago" is the headline. Rico has thoughts. (Spoiler: they involve a healthy dose of skepticism about why we're doing this now.)

content.value:
## The Headline

ESPN — Dave McMenamin: **"Inside LeBron's first game in Philly -- more than two decades ago"**

Look, I get it—LeBron James played basketball in Philadelphia a long time ago, and now ESPN wants to remind us that history happened. That's the kind of line that reads one way in October and a completely different way come April, when we're either celebrating prescience or quietly deleting tweets. Here's the read right now, before anyone's kept score: this is nostalgia bait dressed up as analysis, the kind of "remember when" content that floods the zone every time a legend's career odometer ticks over another milestone. Maybe there's something worth excavating here about how far he's come, or maybe—and hear me out—we're just running out of new angles on a 39-year-old's regular season game in January.

content.title: RICO'S TAKE
content.value: Great plan — if the injury report cooperates.
